name: Navidrome
description: Lightweight Subsonic-compatible music server with a slick web player — works with all Subsonic mobile apps.
compose:
services:
  navidrome:
    image: deluan/navidrome:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:4533"
    environment:
      ND_SCANSCHEDULE: "1h"
    volumes:
      - ${{cfg.music_dir}}:/music:ro
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
